places.quote: he lingered opposite the Temple gate when it closed on Wrayburn and Lightwood
places.note: Inns of Court precinct; the gate is the entrance, the Temple is the place.

places.quote: and that the Temple laid upon my line of road
places.note: Same place as the Temple gate; listed once.

places.quote: like the spectre of one of the many heads erst hoisted upon neighbouring Temple Bar
places.note: Former gateway on the Strand/Fleet Street boundary; historical reference to heads displayed on spikes.
